name: Herod
summary: In the Scarlet Monastery's Armory, Herod trains the Crusade's melee fighters. A renowned champion, he commands the Armory and wages the Crusade's holy war with fierce skill and zeal. Alliance dissidents and the Horde's rulers in Undercity seek his death to weaken the order.

sections.title: The Champion of the Armory
sections.body: Herod commands the Armory within the Scarlet Monastery. Unlike the spellcasters and paladins in the Cathedral, he relies on physical strength. Clad in mail and bearing a massive two-handed axe, he trains cohorts of Scarlet Trainees. He teaches them to fight with fury and destroy anyone beyond the Crusade's cause.

sections.title: A High-Priority Target
sections.body: Herod oversees the weapons and combat training of the Crusade's front-line warriors. Raleigh the Devout, an ex-Crusader disillusioned with the order's madness, lives in Southshore and calls for Herod's death to break its military leadership. In the Undercity, the dreadlord Varimathras also seeks Herod's execution. He wants the dangerous human stronghold cleared from the border of Forsaken territory.

faq.answer: Herod is a human warrior who commands the Armory in the Scarlet Monastery. He is one of the Monastery's four principal leaders and oversees the equipment and training of the Crusade's devoted melee fighters.
Herod waits in a central training ring in the Scarlet Monastery's Armory wing, in northeastern Tirisfal Glades. Viewing galleries surround the ring.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Herod dead?
faq.answer: Varimathras seeks Herod's death on behalf of the Forsaken in the Undercity. He wants to remove a key Scarlet Monastery commander and end the Crusade's threat near Forsaken territory.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want Herod dead?
aliases: in the name of the light
faq.answer: Raleigh the Devout asks Alliance champions to kill Herod. The former Scarlet Crusader, stationed in Hillsbrad Foothills, sees the order's fanatical zealotry and wants its brutal warrior leadership weakened.

faq.q: What happens when Herod is defeated?
faq.answer: When Herod falls, young Scarlet Trainees rush from the surrounding barracks into the ring to avenge him. Their attack shows the devotion he inspired in his students.

faq.q: What kind of fighter is Herod?
faq.answer: Herod is a berserker and a warrior, not a traditional holy paladin. He charges viciously and unleashes sweeping whirlwind strikes, relying on physical fury instead of Holy Light spells.

angles.text: As a warrior, Herod shows how furious whirlwind strikes and reckless aggression can make a fighter feared among the Scarlet Crusade's recruits.
For the Horde, especially the Forsaken, killing Herod carries out Varimathras's order to break the leadership threatening Tirisfal Glades.
As an Alliance hero answering Raleigh the Devout's plea, you can see how leaders like Herod have driven Lordaeron's once-noble defenders into fanatical bloodlust.
